detail.title: WAKE Research: Divergent Values and Path Dependence
detail.summary: Analyzing results from experiment exp-divergent-values-test-110 which yielded a measurable divergence variance of 0.0075, suggesting that reduced coupling allows for value divergence. Next steps involve verifying the consistency of this divergence across different seeds.
